title: Barua ya Kirafiki (Theme 2: Matumizi yafaayo ya dawa)
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 8 Kiswahili; not yet checked by a native Kiswahili teacher; not loaded by the live tutor

skills.key_step: The child finds the parts of a thank-you letter and its message: what was done, why it mattered, and warm thanks.

floor.prerequisite: Knows the parts of a friendly letter.
floor.question: Barua ya kirafiki huanza na?

board.do: Wait for the child to answer before saying anything.
The child labels the parts and the message.

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Barua ya shukrani huandikwa kwa nini?" Kwa nini "kuomba kitu" si jibu sahihi?
Soma tena: "Ni salamu ipi inafaa barua ya shukrani ya kirafiki?" Kwa nini "Mkuu wa Shule" si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Barua ya kirafiki hutumia salamu ya kirafiki.

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Barua huanza kwa nini?" Kwa nini "jina la mwandishi" si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Barua huanza kwa anwani na tarehe.
Taja wazi unachoshukuru na jinsi kilivyokusaidia.

checks.question: Barua ya shukrani huandikwa kwa lengo gani?
Barua ya kirafiki humalizika vipi?
checks.answer: Ni mimi rafiki yako, na jina

skills.key_step: The child plans barua ya kirafiki before writing: the parts in order, then one idea at a time, then checks it against the type.

floor.prerequisite: Writes a correct sentence with a capital letter and a kikomo.
floor.question: Andika sentensi moja kuhusu shule yako.

representations: a model text with its parts labelled
steps: Read the title and say the type.
Check against the checklist and correct.
contexts: a letter or story for a family member

board.say: Insha hii ni ya aina gani, na itakuwa na sehemu zipi?

board.do: Wait for the child to answer before saying anything.
The child fills the three-box plan for "Shukrani kwa Ushauri wa Dawa".

misconceptions.repair: Barua ya kirafiki hutumia lugha ya kirafiki: Mpendwa rafiki, Wako akupendaye.
Baada ya salamu, uliza hali ya rafiki yako kabla ya kueleza ujumbe.
Tarehe huandikwa chini ya anwani ya mwandishi, juu upande wa kulia.

misconceptions.ask: Rafiki yako anakuita kwa jina gani?
misconceptions.repair: Barua ya kirafiki humalizika kwa "Ni mimi rafiki yako," na jina la kwanza.

checks.question: Ni sentensi ipi inafaa katika barua ya kirafiki kuhusu "Shukrani kwa Ushauri wa Dawa"?
Barua ya kirafiki ina sehemu zipi?
